apps.localizedDescription: Tsumiru is a native client for reading manga & manhwa from a Suwayomi-Server instance, built for long webtoon binges. Offline downloads with an on-device catalog, a rebuilt continuous-scroll webtoon reader, incognito mode, and 13 built-in themes.

versions.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added a desktop layout for the Library (@aaronbamblett)
- Added a desktop layout for the series page (@aaronbamblett)
- Added search to the top of every desktop page (@aaronbamblett)
- Added search to every main page on phones (@aaronbamblett)
- Added search for individual settings (@aaronbamblett)
- Added chapter swipe actions on phones (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Web interface** to Server settings to choose and update your server's web interface (@aaronbamblett)

### ⚙️ Changes

- Changed the app font to Inter (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed the Mac app to need macOS 12 or newer (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed **Notifications** to show only on Android, where they work (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed new Flatpak installs to the app ID `app.tsumiru.Tsumiru` (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed **In library** to ask before removing a series (@aaronbamblett)
- Removed the chapter grid view (@aaronbamblett)
- Removed the help text in **Downloads** (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Merged the desktop title bar and page toolbars into one bar (@aaronbamblett)
- Made the desktop sidebar narrower and kept it on every page (@aaronbamblett)
- Gave tablets the desktop layout (@aaronbamblett)
- Added keyboard navigation through search results and covers (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Bookmark** and **Mark previous as read** to chapter selection (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Undo** after marking chapters read or unread (@aaronbamblett)
- Added scroll arrows and **See all** to cover rows on desktop (@aaronbamblett)
- Made sources that fail in **Global Search** show **Retry** (@aaronbamblett)
- Made **Persistent search bar** apply to every page (@aaronbamblett)
- Made Long strip and Webtoon glide with a mouse wheel (@aaronbamblett)
- Moved the Mac logo to the top of the sidebar (@aaronbamblett)
- Made the logo show in full colour on every theme (@aaronbamblett)
- Made buttons that can't be pressed look greyed out (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed downloaded chapters opening slowly on a slow connection (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the browser version failing to connect to newer servers (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed broken covers in the browser version until a reload after signing in (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the Mac app not opening when the keychain refuses access (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed crashes in some extensions' settings and on chapters that need a login (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the series page looking cramped at medium window widths (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed resizing the window during a migration going back to the series page (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the desktop app freezing while resizing the window (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the desktop app crashing on close on Linux (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the desktop sidebar flickering when changing pages (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed a bright line at the edge of cover rows on desktop (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Backup Location** showing the wrong title (@aaronbamblett)

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-x64.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru
```

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under `io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru`; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)
